case_study_list.title: Data Warehouse Migration and Analytics Enhancement for Gifi
case_study_list.content:
Gifi, a key player in the distribution of non-food products at low prices, sought to migrate their database to a more modern infrastructure suited for real-time data management. The challenge was to implement a Snowflake data warehouse to improve their analyses and facilitate the exploitation of their data, notably through the Qlik visualization platform.

Context / Problem

Client Presentation

Gifi is a group specializing in the distribution of home and family products. They face challenges to modernize their data management and analysis systems in order to optimize decision-making.

Challenges / Problem to Solve

Gifi accumulates a large amount of data in JSON format on Azure and wishes to structure it for use in a Snowflake data warehouse. The data concerns various business objects such as products, cash registers, stocks, logistics, among others. The challenge is to build an efficient data flow between Azure Data Lake Service Gen2 and Snowflake.

Mission Objectives

  • Implement the Snowflake data warehouse
  • Integrate all business objects into a structured data model
  • Build an efficient data flow between ADLS Gen2 and Snowflake
  • Facilitate the use of data for analyst teams through Qlik visualizations

Proposed Solution

Action Plan

  • Definition of the data model and business views to integrate the 98 business objects into the data warehouse
  • Establishment of a data flow between ADLS Gen2 and Snowflake using Kafka with Event Grid and Azure Data Factory
  • Automation of SQL query generation and execution from the metadata of business objects using a Python script
  • Design of near real-time delta updates and Snowflake tasks to feed the data warehouse
  • Implementation of a custom Scala function to facilitate the denesting of JSON data

Description of Technologies Used

The technologies used include Snowflake, Python, SQL, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Event Grid, Kafka, Scala, GitHub, and Qlik.

Change Management

The consulting firm guided Gifi's data analysis team on using Qlik visualizations to optimize data exploitation.

Results

Achievement of Objectives

Thanks to the implementation of the Snowflake data warehouse and the improvement of the data flow, Gifi was able to meet its objectives in terms of data structuring and analysis. The near real-time processing of millions of files per day was successfully accomplished.

Benefits for the Client

Gifi benefited from a more efficient data management system and more relevant analyses thanks to the successful implementation of Snowflake and Qlik. The analyst teams were able to explore data more easily and make decisions based on detailed and updated information.

Conclusion / Final Thoughts

The case study demonstrates how the consulting firm was able to assist Gifi in modernizing its data warehouse and improving its analytics capabilities. The migration to Snowflake and the optimization of data flows brought significant added value to Gifi.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
Legal framework – compliance with GDPR and French law

FDTI Consulting declares that the company processes personal data in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of April 27, 2016, relating to the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and the free movement of such data (hereinafter referred to as the GDPR) and French law n° 78-17 of January 6, 1978 relating to data processing, files and freedoms.


On May 25, 2018, the General Data Protection Regulations entered into force. Companies dealing with data must now ensure optimal data protection at all times and be able to demonstrate it by documenting their compliance.


In view of its activity, FDTI Consulting may need to process personal data collected and processed by its customers. The following elements are intended to define internal processing rules at FDTI Consulting and guarantee compliance with personal data in accordance with the GDPR.


In all of its activities, FDTI Consulting considers the protection of personal data to be fundamental and strives as soon as possible to anonymize all the data it processes and to ensure the non-disclosure of data outside the reference legal frameworks.

Governance

The data processed by FDTI never leaves the European Union and is not subject to any jurisdiction outside the European Union.


Our host OVH France is located in France and hosts our services in France. Therefore they are not subject to the Cloud Act

Personal data processing process

Except in special cases, FDTI Consulting does not need personal data to carry out its missions. FDTI Consulting therefore asks its clients not to send it any personal data. In the event of unexpected receipt of personal data, FDTI Consulting will directly destroy this data and notify the sender.


Some personal data may be useful for identification purposes. In this case, FDTI Consulting will ask the data provider to pseudonymize this data. FDTI Consulting will support this pseudonymization.

In the event that the sender hasn't the technical capacities or the human capacities to carry out this pseudonymization in his environment, FDTI Consulting will take care of it. Only one person within FDTI Consulting will therefore have access to this personal data, in order to pseudonymize it and distribute this pseudonymized data within FDTI Consulting.


All personal data used in the context of our work is thus stored in a secure space and respects the consent given by the persons concerned. All this data is then permanently deleted, following the studies and processing necessary for the conduct of our various projects.

use_case_list.title: Court registry automation
use_case_list.challenge: A software vendor for court clerks wanted to embed AI directly into its platform to optimize processing time and accuracy for clerks.
use_case_list.approach: On-prem FastAPI AI stack, tailored LLMs and a TypeScript/SvelteKit portal, fully integrated into the existing system.
use_case_list.impact: Processing time divided by 20 while meeting judicial confidentiality requirements.
details: Critical use cases covered: case summaries, dossier validation, automated extraction of sensitive documents.
Deployment inside the client's VPN with fine-grained monitoring and contractual SLAs.
Self-service portal to generate API keys, track usage and troubleshoot calls.
Re-annotation loops to improve models plus full audit tooling.
Enablement plan with trainings, playbooks and dedicated support.
TypeScript/SvelteKit front-end delivering a frictionless experience alongside legacy tools.

use_case_list.title: Circular economy platform
use_case_list.challenge: After forming a joint venture with an OEM, the circular-economy platform needed to upgrade its existing tool to manage ELV processes (B2B & B2C) under EU constraints.
use_case_list.approach: TypeScript/SvelteKit portal plus Azure Functions APIs on the client's Azure infrastructure (MSSQL, Azure Service Bus) tying into the existing .NET stack to connect owners with ELV centers.
use_case_list.impact: End-to-end traceability for 50k+ vehicles per year powering the group's circular economy branch.
details: End-to-end workflow design for dealers, repair centers and households.
Azure Functions APIs connecting logistics, CRM and finance systems.
Real-time mapping of material flows plus automatic regulatory documents.
Multi-brand/catalog management with local rules and pricing.
Azure infrastructure sized for regulatory peaks and audits.
Operational and regulatory dashboards unifying B2B/B2C flows.
Personalized email notifications for each user (garages, dealers, households) at every workflow step.

use_case_list.title: Battery reuse marketplace
use_case_list.challenge: An automotive manufacturer needed a central tool to manage the collection, recycling and resale of its batteries, in collaboration with its partners and buyers. The tool had to manage complete process traceability to meet regulatory requirements related to the structuring of EPR (Extended Producer Responsibility) systems.
use_case_list.approach: Web marketplace connected to partner ERPs, end-to-end traceability and automated flows to buyers or recyclers, price and terms negotiation with partners integrated in the app.
use_case_list.impact: Several thousand batteries redirected each month by hundreds of owners and service providers, with centralized reporting for authorities and administration interface for client employees.
details: End-to-end platform development, databases and APIs.
Full declaration process for end-of-life batteries plus automatic logistics documents.
API integrations with recyclers and eco-organizations to track pickups, tests and certificates, price offers.
Buyer workspace to source reusable batteries and manage the transaction.
Quality/compliance scoring with shared SLAs.
Regulatory reporting exportable in one click.
Automated email notifications for partners and buyers across pickup, testing and resale steps.
Identity federation through Keycloak for group entities and external partners.

use_case_list.title: Public lighting supervision
use_case_list.challenge: Municipalities and their operators needed a single platform to manage public lighting schedules, detect anomalies and plan maintenance.
use_case_list.approach: AWS S3 + DuckDB/Parquet real-time stack, Shell/Cron pipelines, FastAPI backend and TypeScript/SvelteKit UI for local authorities.
use_case_list.impact: Dynamic lighting schedules and predictive maintenance deployed across 40+ territories.
details: Continuous collection of lighting meters with optimized S3 + Parquet storage.
DuckDB analytics delivering KPIs within seconds over multi-year history.
Alert dashboards for operators (failures, consumption, schedule anomalies).
Open REST API to plug operator and city systems.
Multi-tenant management with granular permissions and per-city segmentation.

use_case_list.title: AI analysis of social narratives
use_case_list.challenge: The NGO needed to compare environmental narratives on Facebook and Instagram to guide communications investments.
use_case_list.approach: LLM methodology (ChatGPT + tailored prompts) scoring tone/topics/perspectives, correlated with Facebook/Instagram KPIs by audience type (age, country, interests) and yielding comparative visuals.
use_case_list.impact: Budget reallocation per country/platform and an internalized analysis framework.
details: Prompts capturing tone, actors, topics and emotions on Facebook/Instagram.
Automated pipeline: social data → LLM → scoring of topics/tones/perspectives per audience type.
Cross-analysis with post performance to recommend priority themes.
Documented methodology replicable by local teams.
Enablement sessions to interpret recommendations and adjust budgets.

use_case_list.title: Data hub & NLP
use_case_list.challenge: Centralize customer review flows from an electronics leader in France and industrialize their analysis with AI and dashboards.
use_case_list.approach: Pipelines to collect data from various providers and collection managers via API Airflow→BigQuery, GCP governance, NLP (HuggingFace, BERTopic, QA, LLM), delivery in Tableau dashboards and internal data distribution to other concerned teams.
use_case_list.impact: Customer service instantly retrieves classified topics, escalated alerts and tracks requests more precisely.
details: Multi-API collection (mystery shopping, CRM, social, reviews) orchestrated by Airflow.
Cloud policies: team segmentation, data localization, security and best practices.
Analysis and classification pipeline with LLMs.
NLP pipelines for similarity, sentiment and topics across multiple languages.
Design and implementation of dashboards used daily by the Customer & Market insights team.
Documentation and training for data/business teams.
Automated insight exports to marketing BUs and agencies.

use_case_list.title: Near real-time data warehouse
use_case_list.challenge: Move 98 Azure JSON business objects (150+ SQL tables/views) into Snowflake to feed Qlik in near real-time.
use_case_list.approach: Target model, ADLS→Snowflake ingestion via Kafka/ADF, auto-generated SQL and delta flows.
use_case_list.impact: Minute-level feeds for BI teams processing millions of files per day.
details: Automatic SQL generation from XML metadata to speed up deployments.
Delta updates orchestrated by Snowflake Tasks with dedicated monitoring.
Custom Scala functions to denormalize nested JSON.
Coaching for analysts to leverage the new real-time feeds.
Environment management via Snowflake API (test / pre-prod / prod).
